# Generated by gen_theme_setup.py; edit the generator and regenerate instead of editing by hand.

# Location scope; scope:target_country = the theme. A town or city of BYZ in the theme's own region, other than its seat.
# Author decision 2026-11-17: towns or larger only (in 1337 most regions have no town besides the seat, so the
# edict becomes available as towns grow).
oe_theme_seat_candidate = {
    owner ?= c:BYZ
    has_variable = oe_theme_region
    exists = scope:target_country
    scope:target_country = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_id exists = capital }
    var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:target_country.var:oe_theme_region_id
    OR = {
        location_rank = location_rank:town
        location_rank = location_rank:city
        location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
    }
    NOT = { this = scope:target_country.capital }
}

# Country scope (BYZ). At least one region centre can found a theme now.
oe_theme_any_creatable = {
    any_owned_location = { oe_theme_region_center_creatable = yes }
}
